fields.title: Title of this paper.
fields.q_matrix_contribution: Does this paper generate, validate, refine, or only use an existing Q-matrix or equivalent item-skill/knowledge-component mapping? Explain briefly. This is not a final eligibility decision.
fields.method_family: One or more of expert-driven, statistical, machine learning, LLM-based; name the actual method. Extract this paper's own contribution, not background citations.
fields.domain: Educational measurement, intelligent tutoring systems and learning analytics, or psychological and clinical assessment; describe the setting.
fields.data_type: Simulated, empirical, both, or neither; identify datasets if reported.
fields.sample_size: Sample sizes, distinguishing empirical samples from simulation conditions and replications.
fields.items_and_attributes: Numbers of assessment items and diagnostic attributes or skills; distinguish conditions.
fields.response_type: Dichotomous or polytomous responses and any other reported response formats.
fields.diagnostic_model: Diagnostic model names used in this study.
fields.evaluation_and_benchmarks: Evaluation criteria for the mapping method and benchmark datasets. Distinguish Q-matrix recovery from attribute classification and prediction accuracy.
fields.author_reported_limitations: Limitations stated by the authors, not limitations inferred by the extractor.
